title: Microlocal defect functionals in VMO: Geometric localisation and applications to highly heterogeneous media
summary: We extend the concept of microlocal defect functionals to test functions belonging to the space $\mathrm{L}^\infty\cap\mathrm{VMO}_c$. Following L.~Tartar's remark that an extension of such concepts to $\mathrm{VMO}$ spaces should be possible, we establish a functional-analytic framework for this extension within the $\mathrm{L}^p-\mathrm{L}^q$ setting. Because the topological dual of $\mathrm{VMO}$ is the Hardy space $\mathcal{H}^1$, the resulting object takes the form of an H-distribution rather than a non-negative Radon measure.
